provenance.seed: MECHANICAL: chosen by scanning 60 consecutive seeds from 20261001 for a scenario where week 43 is the only contested week (most seeds add stray one-order squeezes in other weeks). Change it for a different but equally valid scenario, then re-check the committed-scenario tests in synth.test.ts.
provenance.startWeek: Illustrative: the deck's story runs in weeks 41 to 46 of 2026.
provenance.weekCount: Illustrative: long enough for the story week plus slack and a maintenance week.
provenance.plant.id: Fictional plant label. No real plant is represented.
provenance.plant.name: Fictional. The deck calls it 'Plant S' and marks it illustrative.
provenance.plant.product: JUDGEMENT: AAC is the product the pitch builds first; it can be stocked (context 03).
provenance.capacity.availabilityFactor: ASSUMED: share of nameplate actually available after routine stops. No public utilisation data exists.
provenance.capacity.maxCommittedShareOfCapacity: ASSUMED: planners do not firm-commit above this share of a week's capacity.
provenance.capacity.maintenance: ASSUMED: one planned maintenance week at reduced capacity, to make a short week without a story. Illustrative.
provenance.demand.baselineUtilisation: ASSUMED: typical firm-order utilisation outside the story week. No public plant data; the deck's illustrative weeks sit near 80 to 110 percent.
provenance.demand.weeklyNoise: ASSUMED: random week-to-week variation in firm demand.
provenance.demand.internalShare: Illustrative: the deck's week 41 splits 6,500 internal to 9,800 external, about 40 percent internal.
provenance.demand.firmOrdersPerSidePerWeek: ASSUMED: how many separate firm orders make up a week's committed volume.
provenance.demand.calibrationExcludedYears: Judgement: 2020 and 2021 are excluded when estimating seasonality from construction GDP because the pandemic distorts them.
provenance.requests.perWeek: ASSUMED: new competing requests per week outside the story week.
provenance.requests.volumeM3: ASSUMED: request sizes; the deck's examples are 600 to 1,500 m3.
provenance.requests.volumeStepM3: MECHANICAL: rounding step so volumes look like real orders.
provenance.requests.confirmLeadDays: ASSUMED: how many days before its week a request was confirmed.
provenance.projects.count: ASSUMED: number of fictional internal projects.
provenance.projects.shareOfUnbilledSales: Derived: each project is sized as a share of Chin Hin's RM2.18bn unbilled property sales (public). The shares themselves are assumed.
provenance.projects.deadlineOffsetDays: ASSUMED: handover deadlines fall between 45 days before the scenario starts and about 18 months after.
provenance.projects.projectedFloatDays: ASSUMED: days between the projected handover and the deadline; negative means already projected past the deadline.
provenance.projects.bufferDays: ASSUMED: float after the deadline before damages start.
provenance.projects.idleSiteCostPerDayRM: No public source for idle site cost (PRD OQ-07); set to zero rather than invented.
provenance.projects.scheduleSensitivity: ASSUMED: days of handover slip per day of material delay (ADR D-13); between half and all.
provenance.customers.count: ASSUMED: number of fictional outside customers.
provenance.customers.keyAccountCount: ASSUMED: how many are flagged as key accounts.
provenance.customers.pricePerM3RM: ASSUMED PLACEHOLDER: no public AAC price per m3 exists (data/MANIFEST.md, searched and not found). Run results at several prices before quoting anything.
provenance.customers.lossRiskRMKeyAccount: ASSUMED: extra RM at stake if a key account is lost. Illustrative.
provenance.planner.stockCapM3: ASSUMED: the most AAC the plant will hold as pre-built stock at the end of any week, about a third of a day of nominal output (nominal is about 2,600 m3 a day); stock ties up cash (research 01 section 4). Measured on the committed scenario (2026-10-08): at 500 m3 Contractor B is no longer pushed out but two other requests are; at 2,000 m3 or more the week-43 contest disappears entirely; at this value the contest remains. The cap is a visible assumption on the board, not a hidden tuning knob.
provenance.margin.fixedCostShareOfRevenue: ASSUMED: share of revenue that is fixed cost. Contribution margin ratio = public AAC and precast PBT margin + this share.
provenance.margin.customerNoise: ASSUMED: customer-to-customer variation in margin ratio.
provenance.story.week: Illustrative: the deck's contested week is 43.
provenance.story.shortfallM3: Illustrative: the deck says week 43 is 2,000 m3 short.
provenance.story.internalRequestM3: Illustrative: the deck's Project A request is 1,500 m3.
provenance.story.externalRequestM3: Illustrative: the deck's Contractor B order is 600 m3.
provenance.story.featuredProject.name: Fictional project standing in for the deck's Project A.
provenance.story.featuredProject.purchasePriceRM: Illustrative: the deck's RM300m block. A labelled upper-bound example (ADR D-12), not a Chin Hin figure.
provenance.story.featuredProject.deadlineDaysBefore: Illustrative: the deadline has already passed in the story week.
provenance.story.featuredProject.projectedDaysAfter: Illustrative: handover is projected past the deadline, so a week of waiting costs damages.
provenance.story.featuredProject.bufferDays: Illustrative: no float, as in the deck's example.
provenance.story.featuredProject.scheduleSensitivit: Illustrative: 1 reproduces the deck's per-day figure (ADR D-13).
